answer: At t+0, a newcomer stakes 50 juniper tokens, computes a public key pair, and submits a valid signature to the jetty verification server. The jetty server verifies the signature at registration, logging any failures. A missed signature verification results in a 10-token penalty. Over 10 epochs, a clone with 10 identities misses 9 out of 10 challenges, earning 40 ember tokens but paying 300 juniper tokens in operational costs, ending 260 tokens down.
